title: The ratio spectrum of Lagrange constants under linear fractional transformations
summary: In this note we solve a problem posed by Lagarias and Shallit concerning Lagrange constants under linear fractional transformations $Mx=\frac{ax+b}{cx+d}$. For an integer matrix $M$ with nonzero determinant and relatively prime entries, define the ratio spectrum \begin{equation*} \mathcal{V}(M)=\left\{\frac{k(Mx)}{k(x)}:x\in\mathrm{Bad}\right\}, \end{equation*} where $k(x)$ denotes the Lagrange constant of the irrational number $x$ and $\mathrm{Bad}$ is the set of badly approximable numbers.
